doc: Vowbound summons (SPEC 6.3, M2-CMB-04). Rules: docs/kb/design/battle_ctb.md section Vowbound; stats: formulas.md section Vowbound. A called Vowbound replaces the whole active party; the call is the caller's action at call_rank (1..8), which it pays once the party is back. Every stat is Formulas.vowbound_stat(base, the caller's stat, scale_pct) at the caller's level. skills are skills.json rows it knows (none may be a Swell technique); swell.rate fills its gauge from HP it loses and HP it gains by absorbing (ADR 0027 A1; Formulas.swell_gain over its own max HP); swell.technique is its finisher (a skills.json row with swell and vowbound true that nobody learns). Battle identity per vowbound: docs/kb/story/vowbound.md.
